statement: A descriptor MUST be built from the lockfile's own digest: a registry entry without a digest and a git or path dependency MUST be reported `UNPINNED`, a workspace member `LOCAL`, and a name or version that is not ASCII MUST refuse the lockfile.

decisions.because: First red of the suite: a lockfile whose registry entry was named 'libс' (Cyrillic с) was read without complaint; ASCII was checked only when the descriptor was encoded, so `check` would have crashed with an unhandled exception rather than refusing. The check moved to descriptor construction, then to every lockfile entry once the statement was read again: a workspace member named 'demо-app' still passed.

counterexample.observed: LockfileError not raised (registry entry, then workspace member)
